supporting_observations.claim: The alerted account was created at 13:47:45 UTC, later than the alert's approximate 13:42 time. The creator was greta.lund, and the account name follows the documented temporary-account naming pattern.
greta.lund added temp.rwong to Externals, consistent with the documented group for temporary accounts.

Shortly before the account was created, greta.lund initiated an RDP connection from WS-GLUND-01 to DC-MAP-01 and successfully logged on there. The inventory says remote administration is only done from WS-AHASSAN-01, making this access path inconsistent with the stated practice, but not establishing malicious intent.
